metadata.description: AgenTeX: keep LaTeX papers honest to the code behind them, from first draft to submission.

plugins.name: agentex
plugins.description: Skills and hooks for papers whose results live in code: a desk-rejection gate, verified citations, numbers and figures synced to the code, paper-vs-code checks, a compile loop, review and rebuttal, arXiv packaging, plus talks, posters, CVs, theses and exams.
